summary.text: Mark S. Chang, a Democrat, represents District 32 (Anne Arundel County) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Chang was born in Glen Burnie, Maryland, in 1976, and attended Glen Burnie High School.
The legislature's biography lists a B.A. in psychology from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, and an M.B.A. from Loyola University in 2010.
It describes Chang as a risk management consultant, a former legislative aide to Senator James E. DeGrange, Sr., and a community liaison for Anne Arundel County Government from 2006 to 2013.

sources.title: Delegate Mark S. Chang (Maryland General Assembly)
